run_triviaqa_data_pipeline: run the script to download TriviaQA data and update KILT JSONL files with question inputs
decompress_tar_with_progress: create a function that extracts a tar.gz file to a path with a tqdm progress bar
download_file_with_progress: build a python module that streams a file download from a URL with a tqdm progress bar
extract_question_ids: create a function that reads TriviaQA JSON files and builds a question ID to question text mapping
update_kilt_jsonl_inputs: refactor KILT JSONL files to populate the input field using a question ID mapping
